thin: DV lists are rich but not Mesa-specific: the City's own two victim-services pages are the fullest and mostly name national hotlines and Phoenix shelters. The biggest finding is staleness: Mesa's homeless-resources page and the CoC sheet still send people to SAFEDVS (1-844-SAFEDVS), which closed 15 May 2026, and the lists give Chrysalis and CPLC the same number. Scout already had nearly everything here; it lacked only love is respect, RedRover, the Family Renewal Center and a separate Mesa Family Advocacy Center entry. Hand corrections: SAFEDVS (tool matched the Deaf Hotline) and Mesa Family Advocacy Center (tool matched the Southwest one) set to none.
